why_update_not_attempted: copy_file did not return a newly allocated target ID; replacing an existing backup was forbidden and was not attempted.

orphan_check.scope: One current direct-folder listing at the recorded time; no assertion about a future late response.

diagnostic_findings: The generic Drive upload_file calls returned neither provider completion nor provider error before root interruption.
The independently supported copy_file metadata mutation also returned no new ID before root interruption.
The file_uri declaration explicitly accepts an absolute local string path despite contradictory older prose; the exposed schema was followed. No argument-type rejection was observed.
The Dropbox fileParams adapter uploaded the same local archive bytes and complete remote GET equality was verified; this narrows but does not identify Drive internal failure.
Drive get_file_metadata and list_folder reads succeed. capabilities.canAddChildren was requested but not exposed by normalized output; owner permission and current_user_can_share were returned.
Drive update_file supports raw byte replacement according to advertised metadata, but no actual update_file content trial occurred. It must not be described as a failed content-update trial.
create_file native metadata-only objects and import actions for document formats do not provide a valid ZIP backup substitute.
failure_classification: NO_PROVIDER_RESPONSE_TOOL_WAIT_INTERRUPTED; not a demonstrated permission denial, science failure or payload rejection
observed_host_limitation: Despite requested exec yield the tool await did not return agent control before root interruption.
